text:
Olivia (CSM): Hi team — kicking off alignment for Polaris's first 30 days. Quick goals: make the initial integration stable, get first 3 flows in prod, and validate latency/cost targets.
Raj (Eng Lead - Polaris): Thanks Olivia. Key stakeholder list: Raj (eng), Sam (PM), Mira (security). I'll loop them in after this.
Priya (AE): FYI Polaris is expecting SSO and private deployment guidance. Renewal signal: usage >50k tokens/mo in month 2 is high priority.
Noah (Onboard): Proposed onboarding timeline:
```
Day 0-3: infra & SSO setup
Day 4-10: integration tests + demo flows
Day 11-20: perf tuning + caching
Day 21-30: validation, rollout to 10% traffic
``` 
Lena (SE): I'll own perf tuning sessions and a workshop on batching/kv cache. Suggest 60-min session Day 7.
Olivia (CSM): Success criteria (short): 1) 3 flows live, 2) avg latency <= 350ms p95, 3) cost per 1k tokens within forecast, 4) no SSO blockers. Add others?
Raj (Eng Lead - Polaris): Add: automated smoke tests passing, and a runbook for fallbacks.
Priya (AE): I'll capture this in the contract playbook. Also want feedback loop: weekly survey + a 1:1 at day 30.
Olivia (CSM): For enablement — Noah + Lena will run two office hours/week beginning Day 5. I'll track attendance in the onboarding sheet: https://redwood.internal/onboard/polaris
CS-bot: Reminder — create onboarding channel #polaris-onboard and invite all stakeholders :white_check_mark:
Noah (Onboard): Noted. I'll schedule the Day 7 perf workshop and send calendar invites. Who should be included from Polaris side?
Raj (Eng Lead - Polaris): Sam and Mira + platform eng (TBD). I'll ping them now.
Lena (SE): Quick risk callout: if traffic variance > 3x expected we'll need to enable burst capacity & redo batch config.
Olivia (CSM): Risk/renewal flags: low usage or repeated SSO failures -> flagged for escalation. We'll add gating checkpoints at days 10 and 20.
Priya (AE): Sounds good. I'll prepare a renewal-risk playbook snippet if we see <30% of target usage by day 20.
Olivia (CSM): Great — I'll create the shared doc and initial tasks. Next sync Wednesday 10am PT. :calendar:
Raj (Eng Lead - Polaris): 👍 thanks all
Noah (Onboard): 👍 I'll send invites
Lena (SE): :rocket:
Olivia (CSM): Closing — I'll update the channel once doc is up.
